root_goal.description: Historically distinct astrology rule models across Western/Hellenistic/Jyotish/Chinese/Human Design prospectively frozen and independently evaluated on genuinely untouched humans vs controls.

this_turn.scope: Small reversible event-only score and data-source discovery; not an authorized new requirement on other research.

hypothesis.name: Modern diagnostic primary directions, NOT complete historical Lilly/Argoli
hypothesis.excluded_six_source_candidates: preserved but not eligible for event scoring; source/radix and endpoint unresolved
hypothesis.metric: mean across independently documented positive event age intervals of fraction of each event interval covered by candidate chart windows
hypothesis.date_precision: day/month/year intervals, always coded before chart reveal; uniform-within-reported-event-interval is a tentative researcher-inferred convention
hypothesis.likelihood: not calibrated, not a proper scoring rule; no implied population probabilities
hypothesis.overlapping_contacts: use union of all windows for a domain, event credited at most 1
hypothesis.missing_events: no event record means UNKNOWN, not negative event or no-event true negative
hypothesis.scoring_domain: adult age interval [18,65); exclude out-of-domain ages and explicitly report
hypothesis.primary_null: one-to-one N×N event-case vs chart permutation under predeclared exchangeability/matching strata; no true-chart labels until matrix frozen
hypothesis.incomplete_cohort: report eventless cases and do not produce a pseudocomplete N×N matrix
hypothesis.chart_acceptance: only private Regiomontanian pilot receipt with keyed HMAC, pinned Swiss-file hashes/returned SWIEPH, unchanged source rule registry and declared modern method, not full historical conditions
hypothesis.real_study_state: NOT_FROZEN_OR_REGISTERED; external timestamps, enrollment, outcome assessor, source checks, matching must be independently proven
